honest_interpretation: Cycle 16 source-overlap audit. Near-copy = max char-5gram Jaccard >= 0.82 OR longest-common-substring in combined accepted-train corpus >= 48 chars OR (output >= 32 chars AND longest-common-substring / output >= 0.9). Zero near-copies confirms the NLL improvement (probe 1.494 vs 2.237) is substrate generalization rather than memorization. Note that the Cycle 16 outputs were already manually audited as 0/128 correct coherent English; low source overlap means the substrate is producing genuinely novel character sequences but those sequences are not coherent English.
